scripts.web:build: npm run server:build && npm run build --workspace=kartiseret-web
scripts.web:test: npm run server:build && npm run test --workspace=kartiseret-web
scripts.web:typecheck: npm run server:build && npm run typecheck --workspace=kartiseret-web
scripts.lint: npm run web:lint && npm run lint --workspace=@kartiseret/contracts && npm run lint --workspace=@kartiseret/server
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace=kartiseret-web && prettier --config "Codebase - Kartiseret Web/package.json" --ignore-path .gitignore --check "packages/contracts/src/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/src/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/scripts/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/tests/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/*.ts" "api/*.ts"
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=kartiseret-web && prettier --config "Codebase - Kartiseret Web/package.json" --ignore-path .gitignore --write "packages/contracts/src/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/src/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/scripts/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/tests/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}" "packages/server/*.ts" "api/*.ts"
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run contracts:typecheck && npm run server:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run contracts:build && npm run web:test && npm run api:test
scripts.clean:web-build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('Codebase - Kartiseret Web/dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.verify: npm run contracts:build && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run contracts:typecheck && npm run server:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run api:test && npm run api:typecheck && npm run web:build && npm run web:og:smoke && npm run bundle:check && npm run clean:web-build
scripts.server:build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace=@kartiseret/server
scripts.server:typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run typecheck --workspace=@kartiseret/server
scripts.server:dev: npm run contracts:build && npm run dev --workspace=@kartiseret/server
scripts.server:start: npm run contracts:build && npm run server:build && npm run start --workspace=@kartiseret/server
scripts.api:test: npm run contracts:build && npm run test --workspace=@kartiseret/server
scripts.api:test:integration: npm run contracts:build && npm run db:test:bootstrap && npm run test:integration --workspace=@kartiseret/server
